big-news.text: Norway signed a free trade deal with Vietnam along with the other EFTA countries. Salmon will become duty-free, and over 98% of Norwegian exports will be duty-free within seven years.
Norway's delegates walked out at the IMF meetings in Bangkok while Russia's finance minister spoke, together with Sweden, Denmark, Finland and others.
One more detail on the train strike deal: the drivers get a 36,000 kr raise.
A person was found dead at a cabin in Åmli, in Agder, and one person has been charged.

whats-changing.text: Temu and Shein orders could get pricier. The Green Party (MDG) wants a fee of at least 20 kr on every cheap parcel from outside the EEA from 2027. It's only a demand in the budget talks for now.

be-aware.text: A new, much bigger tick species (Hyalomma) has been found on a child in Oslo. Unlike regular ticks, it actively chases its host, so check yourself after walks in the woods.
Today's a crisp, sunny Sunday in Oslo, around 3°C this morning and about 10°C this afternoon, with no weather warnings.

fun-and-free.text: Top pick: Children's World Days is on today from 11:30 to 16:30 at the Intercultural Museum at Grønland, with music, dance and a world food bazaar.
Høststorm is a free wind concert by Barratt Due students on Tuesday at 18:00. You need to grab a free ticket first.
Asbjørn Ribe plays a free concert with his band at the Oslo Concert Hall on Saturday, Oct 24 at 20:00.
Oslo Creative Festival is free at Deichman Bjørvika on Saturday, Oct 24 from 11:00.
